scope: ArcelorMittal Gent MHI-D-CRBN, Steelanol and Volteron
HIsarna, blast-furnace CCUS, high-grade EAF and scrap, smart steelworks

stale_claims_intentionally_retained.reason: ExxonMobil's May 2026 report reconfirms the contract and non-operating status but does not restate the December 2025 conditional 2026 start-up target.

interpretation_boundaries: HIsarna Jamshedpur is at board-approved engineering and regulatory-approval work, not confirmed FID, EPC, construction or operation.

Jharkhand's LoI and MoU amounts are proposed package values, not HIsarna-only committed CAPEX; the government ₹11,100 crore and Tata report ₹11.1 billion labels differ by a factor of ten. Tata Steel's 2026-03-05 NSE clarification further says the ₹11,000 crore report spans several approved or deliberated projects and that HIsarna and EASyMelt remain additional projects under evaluation.
Steelanol closure was under conditional review in 2025, not confirmed; the May 2026 official update documents repair, leak testing and pre-restart procedure rather than completed restart.

Volteron has completed full-scale-cell validation and industrial engineering design, but no disclosed FID, site, EPC, construction or operation for the 40-80 kt/y plant. The current EC INCITE page independently cross-checks the 1 m² industrial-electrode pilot and engineering/CAPEX study, but its body says TRL 7 was expected by end-2025 while the structured field labels achieved TRL 7; this presentation difference is preserved rather than strengthened into a commercial-maturity claim.
MHI-D-CRBN conducted a Ghent demonstration, but public sources do not disclose conversion rate, CO output or purity, energy intensity, run hours or scale-up decision.

CORDIS now labels EIC grant 101161563 administratively closed after its scheduled 2026-06-30 end date, but publishes no Gent trial results; grant closure is not treated as technical KPI achievement or commercial deployment.
PURESCRAP public deliverables do not establish industrial KPI achievement; D2.2 reproduction restrictions required an AI reconstruction based on the public CORDIS functional configuration.
JFE's AI scrap inspection classifies incoming loads and contamination but does not chemically remove tramp elements.

JFE's machine-learning Cu model predicts molten-steel copper and optimizes scrap blending; it is not a decoppering process, and public material gives no deployment site or quantified accuracy and savings.
Nucor Bushnell physically separates copper and non-ferrous material before EAF charging; it is not molten-steel decoppering, and the company does not disclose the throughput or purity baseline.
Nucor West Virginia's 2026 equipment commissioning is not integrated commercial production; ramp-up is targeted for 2027.
JFE-AWS and ArcelorMittal AI disclosures are deployment or collaboration statements without fleet-wide model accuracy or independently verified productivity evidence.
JFE and Nippon Steel participation in Noetra is foundation-model R&D participation, not proof of steelworks deployment, autonomous control or measured productivity impact.

JFE's blast-furnace hot-metal temperature guidance combines an 8-12 hour physical model with 2-3 hour ML/AI prediction and offers an automatic control mode, but the reported 13% reduction is an operator-followed-guidance result. The displayed sigma values 15.9 to 14.0 C imply about 11.9% by simple arithmetic, and the source does not explain the difference; site, furnace count, duration, heat count and independent validation are undisclosed.

Tata Steel's more than 300 AI agents cover enterprise-wide functions and must not be represented as 300 process-control agents; Safety EyeQ is monitoring and alerting, not disclosed autonomous equipment control.
The ArcelorMittal-AWS June 2026 collaboration lists intended cloud and edge AI use cases; it does not disclose completion across all sites or measured performance.
Nippon Steel has remote operation in some areas and targets unmanned logistics deployment from FY2026 onward; neither wording supports fleet-wide completion.

PURESCRAP's February 2026 steering update says test results were still being evaluated and the next experimental phase was being prepared; it is progress evidence, not proof of impurity-removal or steel-quality KPI achievement.

JFE's 150 m³ carbon-recycling test blast furnace began operation in May 2025, replacing the older 'planned' wording; this is pilot operation, not commercial BF-CCUS deployment, and no achieved CO2-reduction KPI is public.
DOE/NETL's Gallatin categorical-exclusion record confirms the polishing-loop installation and test scope, not completed construction, integrated testing or achievement of the <100 ppm target.

PURESCRAP Newsletter No. 7 documents successful Swerim testing and the April 2026 relocation of the heavy-scrap station to Stena Hallstahammar, but calls this movement toward full industrial operation; it does not disclose quantified sensor, removal, throughput, uptime, steel-quality, CO2 or 40% scrap-share KPI achievement.

The undated PURESCRAP homepage still describes the heavy-scrap station at Swerim Luleå, while the dated 2026-07-23 newsletter reports its April 2026 relocation to Stena Hallstahammar. The dated newsletter is used for current project status and the homepage wording is retained as an earlier-stage description.

Nucor's 2026-07-27 Q2 earnings release was checked at its 16:30 ET publication time. It contains no West Virginia sheet-mill, Apple Grove, Convent CCS, carbon-capture, construction-schedule or 2027 ramp-up detail, so it was not registered as C-scope project evidence and no claim was reverified from it.

failed_sources.reason: Search cache exposed a June 2026 Steelanol pressure-release notice, but the live URL redirects to an unrelated coke-oven-gas compressor test page. It was not registered or used as current-status evidence.

Targeted searches did not identify a project-specific HIsarna Jamshedpur environmental-clearance record. Generic Tata Steel mining or plant-expansion records were excluded and no regulatory-approval completion claim was created.

Targeted Arkansas DEQ searches found 2026 Big River Steel water and air permit records for wastewater, grain-oriented steel units and a second RH degasser, but no DRI-facility-specific permit. Those unrelated records were excluded and the announced Big River DRI investment was not upgraded to permitted construction.

WVDEP's current NSR index lists Nucor West Virginia modification R14-0039B with final-permit and final-determination links, but the document server repeatedly timed out. The index signal was not treated as proof of the modification scope, signed date, construction completion or operation.
